jobs.title: Head of Model Validation and Governance Canada
jobs.description:
Join one of Montreal’s Top Employers in 2026. We are a leading international banking institution fully committed to building a more sustainable future.

The position at a glance

This role supports BNP Paribas’s mission by strengthening the risk management framework through robust model governance and independent review. The position aims to coordinate the North American model governance framework while ensuring alignment with global standards and regulatory requirements. The primary objective is to provide regional coordination and effective challenge to maintain the integrity of quantitative and AI models used across North America and the Group.

In detail

Lead the RISK IRC team in Canada by integrating activities into the global operating model to ensure coherent contribution to global priorities.
Supervise North American Model Governance by managing regional processes and reporting to address Canadian and US regulatory needs.
Coordinate with stream and technical review leads across multiple locations to allocate work and resolve escalations for consistent delivery.
Build collaborative relationships with model developers and senior management to provide effective challenge as a second line of defense.
Contribute to the development of model validation practices by promoting high standards and producing reports for management and regulators.
Manage the ongoing professional development of direct reports by providing continuous coaching and feedback to encourage growth.
Apply reasoned decision-making when addressing work challenges to provide practical solutions in complex environments.
Maintain accountability for following policies and procedures to ensure organized and accurate job performance.

The Strengths And Skills That Will Help You Succeed

Master’s Degree in Quantitative field
Minimum 10–12 years of relevant experience, including senior responsibility for model governance, independent review, and regulatory engagement.
The knowledge of English is required.*
Strong quantitative skills in econometrics, statistics, or applied mathematics when performing model reviews.
Comprehensive knowledge of bank products and business practices to ensure accurate assessment.
Familiarity with model risk management practices and regulatory guidance to maintain compliance.
Effective written and verbal communication when presenting information to diverse internal and external stakeholders.
Collaborative relationship building when working within a matrix environment involving various technical leaders.
People-manager responsibilities: Oversee the ongoing professional development of direct reports through coaching and feedback.
Given the vast majority of our clients, both internal and external, are based outside of Quebec and Canada, specific language requirements may apply. Professional working proficiency in French and English languages are required.

While the description above describes our ideal candidate, we encourage applicants to apply even if they do not fully meet the complete list of qualifications noted

What’s In It For You

Alongside a competitive compensation, we provide a comprehensive suite of flexible benefits designed to support your health, wellbeing, and long‑term success:

Health & Wellness
– A menu of flexible options for you and your family, including a 24/7 telemedicine service.

Mental
‑ Health Support
– Up to $5,000 per year for sessions with mental‑health practitioners, plus unlimited access through our Employee Assistance Program.

Financial Benefits
– A defined‑contribution pension plan and a range of additional financial perks.

Paid Volunteering Days
– Take time off to give back to the community.

Learning & Development
– Access to high‑quality training, personal‑development programs, and clear pathways for internal career progression across our global organization.

Work
‑ place flexibility
– Hybrid work is available for most roles. You’ll be required in the office at least three days per week, with one of those days being either a Monday or a Friday.

BNP Paribas is committed to fostering a work environment where all employees can feel heard, valued, safe and supported, and can be their authentic selves.

BNP Paribas recruits, employs, trains, compensates and promotes regardless of race, religion, colour, national origin, sex, disability, age, and other protected status (Employment Equity Act and Canadian Human Right Act).

BNP Paribas, the leading bank in the European Union and a major global financial institution, operates in 63 countries and has nearly 178,000 employees. Its mission is to foster a responsible, sustainable economy by financing and advising clients to the highest ethical standards while addressing environmental, regional development, and social inclusion concerns. With over 1,700 employees in Montreal and Toronto, BNP Paribas in Canada strives to develop long-term relationships with its clients by supporting their business strategies and meeting their financing and investment needs, both locally and abroad.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Corporate Strategy & Development
jobs.description:
Are you ready to embark on a career that truly affects people around the world? Trulioo invites you to be a catalyst for change in the dynamic realm of digital identity verification. As the global front-runner in our industry, we are redefining how businesses grow, innovate and comply online.

Picture yourself at the forefront of innovation, contributing to our award-winning platform that enables organizations worldwide to quickly onboard customers, optimize costs and combat fraud. Fueled by Silicon Valley support, Trulioo stands as the trusted platform that can verify more than 5 billion people and 700 million business entities spanning 195 countries.

But Trulioo is more than a tech company. We are a united force of dedicated experts committed to establishing trust online - and we’re proud to be recognized as a BC Top Employer for the second consecutive year
, reflecting our commitment to an inclusive, collaborative, and people-first workplace.

Headquartered in Vancouver and with strategic hubs in San Diego and Dublin, we foster a culture of collaboration and open communication. Our offices support a hybrid model and staff typically work three days per week at a hub location. Join us where excitement meets innovation and contribute to a world where trust and technology unite.

What We Offer

Comprehensive Benefits: We provide a robust benefits package for full-time, permanent employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plans with company match, paid time off, parental leave, and an annual education & training stipend (equivalent to $1,000 in local currency). Specific benefits may vary by location and will be discussed further during the interview process.
Flexible Hybrid Working Environment: Our offices are designed to support both collaboration and flexibility. Enjoy weekly lunches, quality coffee, and regular social events. Many locations also feature parent rooms, on-site gyms, comfortable lounges, and adaptable workstations to support your comfort and productivity.
Wellness: We care about your well-being. Team members have access to wellness workshops and events, as well as a complimentary Headspace subscription to help you stay focused, grounded, and energized.
Employee Resource Groups: Belonging is an important part of doing your best work. Our ERGs provide an inclusive space, support and community for employees of diverse backgrounds and allies. We host informative, fun sessions and celebrations that are often open to the entire organization.

Position Summary

Trulioo is seeking a Senior Director of Corporate Strategy & Development to help shape the company’s strategic direction and translate it into coordinated action across the business. Working closely with the Chief Risk & Strategy Officer, this leader will own the continued evolution of Trulioo’s strategic blueprint, strengthen alignment between corporate strategy and functional priorities, and guide execution of the company’s most important strategic initiatives.

This role will build the intelligence, governance, and execution capabilities that allow Trulioo to anticipate market change and make informed choices about where and how to compete. The Senior Director will bring together customer, competitive, regulatory, economic, industry, and product insights to test strategic assumptions, identify emerging opportunities and risks, and inform decisions across organic investment, partnerships, and acquisitions.

This is a highly visible enterprise leadership role at the intersection of strategy, product, transformation, capital allocation, and corporate development. The ideal candidate combines forward-looking strategic judgment with the ability to operationalize ideas—building roadmaps, mobilizing accountable leaders, guiding complex programs, and creating the governance needed to turn strategy into measurable results.

This role is expected to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, and continuously optimize how work is performed.

This will be a full-time, permanent position, working remotely.

What You'll Be Doing

Corporate Strategy and Strategic Blueprint Support

Continuously test the strategy against market forces, competitive dynamics, regulatory developments, customer needs, technology shifts, and emerging opportunity areas.
Partner with the Chief Risk & Strategy Officer to prepare strategic recommendations and decision materials for executives, the Board, external advisors, and other key stakeholders.
Design scenario analyses that evaluate strategic assumptions, alternative market outcomes, competitive responses, investment choices, and potential disruptions.
Identify material risks to the strategy and partner with the Enterprise Risk Office to assess exposure, define responses, and integrate strategic risks into enterprise governance.
Develop clear points of view on competitive positioning, market adjacencies, thematic investments, and the capabilities Trulioo will need to win over the long term.
Co-lead recurring strategy reviews and recommend when elements of the strategic blueprint should be accelerated, refined, reprioritized, or recast.

Strategy Alignment and Execution

Translate the strategic blueprint into enterprise priorities, functional goals, measurable outcomes, and clear execution roadmaps.
Partner with executive and functional leaders to align their strategies, investments, roadmaps, OKRs, KPIs, and/or incentives with the company’s strategic direction.
Define the scope, activities, sequencing, investment requirements, accountabilities, dependencies, and measures of success for major strategic programs.
Establish and chair governance forums that track progress against strategic priorities and create clear paths for decision-making and escalation.
Partner with the Transformation Office and accountable workstream leaders to mobilize initiatives, resolve cross-functional blockers, measure progress and performance, and redirect execution when outcomes move off course.
Create recurring feedback loops, including shared metrics reviews and strategy check-ins, to identify misalignment early and improve execution.
Communicate the strategy across the organization in ways that build understanding of Trulioo’s direction, strategic choices, and highest-priority activities.

MAPS and Capital Allocation Governance

Lead MAPS—Trulioo’s quarterly Market Aligned Product Strategy program—to connect corporate strategy and market intelligence with product strategy, investment decisions, and roadmaps.
Bring together Product, Engineering, Strategy, Risk and Reg, Sales, Marketing, and GTM leaders to evaluate emerging customer needs and market opportunities.
Guide structured decisions on whether Trulioo should build, buy, partner, watch, or pass in response to identified opportunities.
Oversee the development of MAPS insight packages covering regulatory change, voice of the customer, competitive moves, market potential, cost of missed opportunity, industry trends, and product performance.
In coordination with the Office of the CFO, develop and operate a disciplined capital allocation governance program that connects strategic priorities with investment decisions.
Build decision frameworks that clarify opportunity, strategic fit, expected value, investment requirements, trade-offs, risks, and measures of success.
Produce a forward-looking point of view on capital allocation priorities informed by Trulioo’s competitive position, portfolio performance, and emerging growth opportunities.

Corporate Development and M&A

Support the development of Trulioo’s Build, Buy, and Partner strategy by identifying capability gaps and evaluating inorganic paths to accelerate the strategic blueprint.
Support market mapping, opportunity screening, target identification, strategic fit assessments, and ongoing target monitoring.
Coordinate cross-functional due diligence, including workstream planning, information synthesis, issue escalation, decision support, and executive reporting.
Contribute to due diligence activities and deal-structure considerations in partnership with Finance, Legal, Product, Technology, Risk, and external advisors.
Develop scalable models, AI agents, and analytical tools that strengthen opportunity screening, target intelligence, diligence, and transaction decision-making.
Capture relevant integration considerations during diligence and translate findings into clear implications for value creation, execution complexity, and transaction risk.

Market Insights and Strategic Intelligence

Design and operate Trulioo’s enterprise market insights program as a continuously running intelligence engine for strategy, product development, investment, and commercialization.
Produce forward-looking insights, including market landscapes, competitive positioning, opportunity sizing, thematic investment perspectives, regulatory outlooks, and voice-of-the-customer analysis.
Build repeatable methods for gathering, validating, synthesizing, and distributing intelligence across the organization.
Translate complex signals into clear strategic implications, executive-level reporting, and actionable recommendations.
Deliver relevant insights to executives, Product, Engineering, Risk and Regulatory, Marketing, Sales, and GTM teams through recurring briefings, dashboards, decision forums, and targeted analyses.
Develop measures that demonstrate how market intelligence improves strategic decisions, product prioritization, capital allocation, and commercial outcomes.

What You'll Bring

15+ years of experience across corporate strategy, corporate development, strategic finance, management consulting, market intelligence, transformation, or related leadership roles.
Significant experience in one or more relevant sectors, including payments, financial services, banking, marketplaces, SaaS, fintech, identity, fraud, or RegTech.
A degree in economics, business, finance, strategy, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
A builder mindset and strong experience working and deploying AI tools and models to improve functional processes, drive automation, rethink problem solving, and transform traditional ways of working.
Demonstrated experience developing corporate or product strategies and translating them into enterprise priorities, functional roadmaps, investment decisions, and measurable outcomes.
Experience operating in complex, global, and highly cross-functional organizations.
Experience leading large-scale strategic or transformation programs involving multiple executives, functions, and dependencies.
Meaningful experience supporting acquisitions, including opportunity assessment, target screening, due diligence, transaction analysis, and integration planning.
Advanced analytical and scenario-planning capabilities, with the ability to work through ambiguity and make clear recommendations from incomplete or conflicting information.
Exceptional executive communication skills and experience preparing materials for executive leadership, Boards, and external advisors.
The judgment and executive presence to influence senior leaders, challenge assumptions, facilitate difficult trade-offs, and drive decisions.

Nice To Have

Exposure to identity verification, fraud prevention, credit insights, financial crime, or regulatory technology.
Experience supporting IPO readiness, public-company strategy, or Board-level capital allocation processes.
Direct experience leading post-acquisition integration or value-creation programs.
An advanced degree in economics, business, finance, or a related discipline.

Thriving at Trulioo

At Trulioo, you’re not just an employee. You’re a valued member of our Trulicrew on a journey of professional and personal growth with a world-class organization. With Trulioo, you have the power to revolutionize the intersection of technology, digital trust and online identity to open the global economy to everyone. Together, we

jobs.title: Dedicated Support Engineer - Toronto
jobs.description:
About The Team

OpenAI’s User Operations team shepherds our customers’ adoption of AI and ensures that our customers' product experience is nothing short of exceptional. We are building the very first post-AGI support team. We resolve complex issues, provide technical guidance, and support customers in maximizing value and adoption from deploying our products. We work closely with Sales, Technical Success, Product, Engineering and others, to deliver the best possible experience to our customers at scale. OpenAI's customers represent a range of diverse backgrounds and maturity, from early-stage startups to established global enterprises.

About The Role

The Support Engineering team works closely with Engineering, Product, Technical Success, Go-to-Market, and other teams to deliver an exceptional experience for our most strategic customers. We combine deep technical troubleshooting with durable customer context, proactive reliability work, and clear ownership during critical moments. We use automation, agents, and our own technology to help build the future of technical support.

We’re looking for experienced, deeply curious technical problem-solvers to serve as trusted support partners for our Premium Support customers. You’ll work directly with customers on novel, ambiguous, and high-impact technical issues, using logs, telemetry, reproduction, and systems-level investigation to isolate causes and drive issues toward resolution.

Beyond resolving individual issues, you’ll use your deep understanding of OpenAI’s infrastructure and products, together with each customer’s architecture and operating context, to anticipate risk and make their workloads more resilient over time. You’ll proactively monitor integrations, identify emerging failure patterns and architectural breakpoints, and work with customers and internal teams to address them before they become incidents. Success means that as a customer’s workloads mature and scale, the day-to-day effort required to support them decreases through better monitoring, runbooks, automation, and preventative improvements.

This Toronto-based role is currently remote and is expected to transition to an in-office arrangement.

In This Role, You Will

Work directly with Premium Support customers to troubleshoot their most complex technical issues, including API failures, integration challenges, authentication errors, unexpected product behavior, performance degradation, and production incidents.
Provide end-to-end technical ownership by analyzing logs and system behavior, reproducing errors, testing hypotheses, and isolating the likely failure domain. Where possible, you’ll identify the root cause before escalating to Engineering; where that is not possible, you’ll provide a clear hypothesis and the evidence needed to accelerate Engineering’s investigation.
Become a trusted expert on OpenAI’s products and systems, serving as a critical escalation point and a technical backstop for our most strategic customers.
Own the customer-specific response to high-impact incidents. You’ll assess severity and business impact, initiate the appropriate response path, coordinate cross-functional responders, maintain clear ownership, and ensure issues move through mitigation, resolution, and post-incident follow-through.
Communicate clearly and proactively during periods of uncertainty, providing accurate updates to customer technical teams, business stakeholders, executives, and internal partners.
Develop a detailed understanding of each customer’s architecture, integrations, dependencies, critical workloads, and operational constraints. You’ll document this context and make it accessible to Support, Product, and Engineering teams.
Partner with Go-to-Market and Technical Success teams to understand the business importance of customer workloads and ensure that relevant commercial context informs severity, prioritization, and communication without bypassing established support processes.
Represent Support Engineering in relevant customer meetings, including QBRs, and partner closely with account teams to communicate technical health, surface risks and blockers early, coordinate follow-up, and provide customers and internal stakeholders with clear, proactive updates.
Monitor customer integrations and support trends to identify emerging risks, recurring failure patterns, and readiness gaps before they become major escalations.
Prepare for important launches, migrations, traffic increases, and business events by developing account-specific runbooks, validating escalation paths, coordinating support readiness, and providing heightened monitoring where needed.
Lead or contribute to incident reviews and postmortems, identify opportunities to prevent recurrence, and track corrective actions through closure.
Translate recurring customer pain into clear, evidence-backed feedback for Product and Engineering, with a particular focus on improving the reliability and performance of existing products, integrations, and deployments.
Turn what you learn from customer investigations into scalable improvements, including troubleshooting guides, monitoring, internal tooling, support workflows, and AI-powered automation.
Help shape the operating model, technical standards, and tooling for Premium Support as the function grows globally.

You Might Thrive In This Role If You

Have significant experience in Support Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or another role involving hands-on diagnosis of complex production issues.
Have expert-level troubleshooting skills and a strong track record of resolving ambiguous technical problems across APIs, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise integrations.
Are comfortable working with logs, metrics, traces, API requests, authentication flows, and customer-provided code or configurations to understand system behavior and test hypotheses.
Have experience leading or playing a central role in customer-impacting incidents, including severity assessment, technical coordination, stakeholder communication, root-cause analysis, and post-incident follow-through.
Can write code or scripts to reproduce issues, interrogate systems, automate repetitive work, and improve internal tools. Experience with Python, JavaScript, or similar languages is valuable.
Can communicate complex technical issues clearly to engineers, customer technical teams, business stakeholders, and senior leaders—especially when information is incomplete or evolving.
Build strong, high-trust relationships with customers and cross-functional partners while maintaining clear and scalable ownership boundaries.
Look beyond the immediate issue to identify patterns, improve the system, and prevent the same problem from recurring.
Thrive in ambiguity, update quickly as new information emerges, and are willing to learn whatever is needed to get the job done.
Bring a humble, team-first mindset, strong judgment, and a genuine eagerness to help both customers and colleagues succeed.
Are excited to use OpenAI’s products, agents, and emerging AI capabilities to transform how technical support operates at scale.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

jobs.description:
En tant que Leader de pratique en stratégie de l'intelligence artificielle, vous jouez un rôle clé au sein du bureau du chef des données et intelligence artificielle, en accompagnant les différents secteurs de l’organisation dans la génération, la priorisation et la mise en œuvre de leurs initiatives en analytique et en intelligence artificielle (IA). Votre mandat consiste à aider les équipes à tirer pleinement profit des données et de l’intelligence artificielle pour atteindre leurs objectifs d’affaires. Pour ce faire, vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les partenaires d’affaires afin de bien comprendre leurs enjeux, d’identifier les opportunités et d’aligner les efforts analytiques sur les priorités stratégiques de l’organisation. Vous réalisez également une vigie stratégique sur les avancées en IA et les pratiques du marché. Avec les secteurs, vous menez des démarches de recensement des opportunités à partir des processus d’affaires et contribuez aux réflexions sur leur transformation par l’IA. Vous aidez ainsi l’organisation à repérer non seulement les tâches à améliorer, mais aussi les processus à repenser. Plus spécifiquement, vous serez amené(e) à :

Accompagner les secteurs d’affaires dans la génération, la priorisation et l'adoption des opportunités en intelligence artificielle, alignées avec les priorités d’affaires.
Accompagner les secteurs dans l’élaboration de leur stratégie en intelligence artificielle.
Agir comme le point de contact privilégié en intelligence artificielle entre le secteur d’affaires et le bureau du Chef des données et analytique Mouvement.
Réaliser des vigies sur les opportunités en IA sur le marché et à l'interne concernant l’intelligence artificielle pour les secteurs d’affaires et fonction de soutien afin d’identifier des opportunités analytiques.
Mener des activités d'idéation d'opportunités en intelligence artificielle pour les secteurs d’affaires, basés sur les processus d'affaires afin de déterminer les meilleurs prochains projets en IA à mettre en œuvre
Structurer et documenter les opportunités en IA sous forme de fiches mandat en qualifiant l’objectif d’affaires, le contexte, la valeur d'affaires, les données et la complexité.
Réaliser une vigie interne et externe en IA et en dégager les implications concrètes pour la stratégie et les secteurs d’affaires.
Mener, avec les secteurs, des démarches de recensement des opportunités IA à partir des processus, des activités et des parcours membres et clients.
Préparer des analyses et des recommandations claires pour la haute direction et les instances décisionnelles.

Ce que nous offrons*

Salaire concurrentiel et boni annuel
4 semaines de vacances flexibles dès la première année
Régime de retraite à prestations déterminées qui assure un revenu prévisible et stable durant toute la retraite
Régime d’assurance collective incluant des services de télémédecine
Remboursement des frais liés à la santé, au bien-être et à de l’équipement pour le télétravail
Les avantages sont applicables en fonction des critères d’admissibilité.

Ce que vous mettrez à profit

Baccalauréat en administration, en stratégie, en transformation organisationnelle, en technologies, en analytique ou dans une discipline appropriée
Un minimum de huit ans d'expérience pertinente
Veuillez noter que d’autres combinaisons de formation et d’expérience pertinentes pourraient être considérées
Expérience significative en stratégie d’entreprise, en transformation ou dans la conduite de dossiers transversaux au sein d’une grande organisation
Expérience significative dans la structuration d'enjeux complexes, la remise en question d'hypothèses et la formulation de recommandations claires et applicables
Expérience passée dans un rôle nécessitant un excellent sens politique et une capacité à influencer des parties prenantes aux priorités différentes, sans autorité hiérarchique directe
Expérience en analyse ou en transformation de processus
Connaissance du français nécessaire
Maîtrise des techniques de rédaction, de synthèse et de communication en français
Connaissance avancée de l’intelligence artificielle, de son potentiel d’affaires, de ses fondements, des principes de sa gouvernance et des principaux risques qui y sont associés. Une expertise technique approfondie n’est pas requise.

jobs.title: Artificial Intelligence Strategy Practice Leader
jobs.description:
Required

As Artificial Intelligence Strategy Practice Leader, you play a key role in the Office of the Chief Data and Analytics Officer, which helps various sectors across the organization generate, prioritize and implement analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) initiatives. You help teams take full advantage of data and AI to achieve their business objectives. To do this, you work closely with business partners to understand their challenges, identify opportunities and align analytical efforts with the organization’s strategic priorities. You also conduct strategic monitoring of AI developments and market practices. Working with the sectors, you lead efforts to find opportunities based on business processes and take part in discussions on transforming them through AI. By doing so, you help the organization identify tasks that need improvement and processes that need to be redesigned More specifically, you will be required to :

Help business sectors create, prioritize and adopt AI opportunities, aligned with business priorities
Support business sectors as they develop their AI strategies
Act as the main point of contact for AI between the business sectors and the Office of Desjardins Group’s Chief Data and Analytics Officer
Monitor market trends and internal AI activity across business sectors and support functions to identify opportunities for analytics
Hold brainstorming sessions to explore process-focused AI opportunities in different business sectors to determine which AI projects to prioritize
Create project briefs for AI opportunities, defining the business objective, context, business value, data requirements and complexity
Conduct internal and external monitoring of AI developments and determine their practical implications for the strategy and business sectors
Work with business sectors to lead initiatives to identify AI opportunities across processes, activities and member and client journeys
Prepare clear analyses and recommendations for senior management and decision-making bodies.

What we offer*

Competitive salary and annual bonus
4 weeks of flexible vacation starting in the first year
Defined benefit pension plan that provides predictable, stable income throughout retirement
Group insurance including telemedicine
Reimbursement of health and wellness expenses and telework equipment
Benefits apply based on eligibility criteria.

What You Bring To The Table

Bachelor’s degree in administration, strategy, organizational transformation, technology, analytics or a related field
A minimum of eight years of relevant experience
Please note that other combinations of qualifications and relevant experience may be considered
Significant experience in corporate strategy, transformation or execution of cross-sector initiatives in a large organization
Significant experience structuring complex issues, challenging assumptions and formulating clear, actionable recommendations
Experience in a role that calls for excellent political acumen and the ability to influence individuals with differing priorities, without direct reporting authority
Experience in process analysis or transformation
Knowledge of French is required
Excellent French-language writing, synthesis and communication skills
Advanced knowledge of AI, its business potential, its foundations, its governance principles and the primary risks associated with it; in-depth technical expertise not required
Knowledge of Desjardins or experience in a large financial institution

Action oriented, Customer Focus, Differences, Innovation, Interpersonal Savvy, Nimble learning, Strategic mindset

Equity, Diversity, Inclusion and Accessibility

At Desjardins, we believe in equity, diversity and inclusion. new_jobs.title: Leader de pratique, Stratégie de l'intelligence artificielle-FR
new_jobs.description:
En tant que Leader de pratique en stratégie de l'intelligence artificielle, vous jouez un rôle clé au sein du bureau du chef des données et intelligence artificielle, en accompagnant les différents secteurs de l’organisation dans la génération, la priorisation et la mise en œuvre de leurs initiatives en analytique et en intelligence artificielle (IA). Votre mandat consiste à aider les équipes à tirer pleinement profit des données et de l’intelligence artificielle pour atteindre leurs objectifs d’affaires. Pour ce faire, vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les partenaires d’affaires afin de bien comprendre leurs enjeux, d’identifier les opportunités et d’aligner les efforts analytiques sur les priorités stratégiques de l’organisation. Vous réalisez également une vigie stratégique sur les avancées en IA et les pratiques du marché. Avec les secteurs, vous menez des démarches de recensement des opportunités à partir des processus d’affaires et contribuez aux réflexions sur leur transformation par l’IA. Vous aidez ainsi l’organisation à repérer non seulement les tâches à améliorer, mais aussi les processus à repenser. Plus spécifiquement, vous serez amené(e) à :

Accompagner les secteurs d’affaires dans la génération, la priorisation et l'adoption des opportunités en intelligence artificielle, alignées avec les priorités d’affaires.
Accompagner les secteurs dans l’élaboration de leur stratégie en intelligence artificielle.
Agir comme le point de contact privilégié en intelligence artificielle entre le secteur d’affaires et le bureau du Chef des données et analytique Mouvement.
Réaliser des vigies sur les opportunités en IA sur le marché et à l'interne concernant l’intelligence artificielle pour les secteurs d’affaires et fonction de soutien afin d’identifier des opportunités analytiques.
Mener des activités d'idéation d'opportunités en intelligence artificielle pour les secteurs d’affaires, basés sur les processus d'affaires afin de déterminer les meilleurs prochains projets en IA à mettre en œuvre
Structurer et documenter les opportunités en IA sous forme de fiches mandat en qualifiant l’objectif d’affaires, le contexte, la valeur d'affaires, les données et la complexité.
Réaliser une vigie interne et externe en IA et en dégager les implications concrètes pour la stratégie et les secteurs d’affaires.
Mener, avec les secteurs, des démarches de recensement des opportunités IA à partir des processus, des activités et des parcours membres et clients.
Préparer des analyses et des recommandations claires pour la haute direction et les instances décisionnelles.

Ce que nous offrons*

Salaire concurrentiel et boni annuel
4 semaines de vacances flexibles dès la première année
Régime de retraite à prestations déterminées qui assure un revenu prévisible et stable durant toute la retraite
Régime d’assurance collective incluant des services de télémédecine
Remboursement des frais liés à la santé, au bien-être et à de l’équipement pour le télétravail
Les avantages sont applicables en fonction des critères d’admissibilité.

Ce que vous mettrez à profit

Baccalauréat en administration, en stratégie, en transformation organisationnelle, en technologies, en analytique ou dans une discipline appropriée
Un minimum de huit ans d'expérience pertinente
Veuillez noter que d’autres combinaisons de formation et d’expérience pertinentes pourraient être considérées
Expérience significative en stratégie d’entreprise, en transformation ou dans la conduite de dossiers transversaux au sein d’une grande organisation
Expérience significative dans la structuration d'enjeux complexes, la remise en question d'hypothèses et la formulation de recommandations claires et applicables
Expérience passée dans un rôle nécessitant un excellent sens politique et une capacité à influencer des parties prenantes aux priorités différentes, sans autorité hiérarchique directe
Expérience en analyse ou en transformation de processus
Connaissance du français nécessaire
Maîtrise des techniques de rédaction, de synthèse et de communication en français
Connaissance avancée de l’intelligence artificielle, de son potentiel d’affaires, de ses fondements, des principes de sa gouvernance et des principaux risques qui y sont associés. Une expertise technique approfondie n’est pas requise.
Connaissance de Desjardins ou expérience dans une grande institution financière

Apprécier les différences, Apprendre avec agilité, Être orienté client, Être orienté vers l’action, Faire preuve d’esprit stratégique, Maîtriser les relations interpersonnelles, Stimuler l’innovation

Équité, diversité, inclusion et accessibilité

Chez Desjardins, on croit à l’équité, à la diversité et à l’inclusion. Nous nous engageons à accueillir toutes les personnes, à les considérer et à les valoriser pour ce qu’elles sont, à nous enrichir de leurs différences et de leur unicité et, surtout, à leur offrir un environnement de travail où elles seront bien. Pour nous, la discrimination, peu importe ses formes, c’est tolérance zéro! Nous croyons en l’importance que nos équipes soient le reflet de la diversité de nos membres, de notre clientèle et des communautés que nous servons.

Si vous avez besoin d’assistance pour rendre plus accessible le processus de recrutement ou le poste pour lequel vous postulez, veuillez nous en informer. Des mesures d’aménagement seront offertes aux personnes qui en font la demande à n’importe quelle étape du processus de recrutement.
